stats: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_movies, COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(YEAR, 0)) AS years, COALESCE(SUM(FILESIZE), 0)*1048576 AS total_size, ROUND(COALESCE(AVG(NULLIF(RATING, 0)), 0), 1) AS average_rating, ROUND(COALESCE(AVG(NULLIF(LENGTH, 0)), 0), 0) AS average_runtime, COALESCE(MIN(NULLIF(YEAR, 0)), 0) AS oldest_year, COALESCE(MAX(NULLIF(YEAR, 0)), 0) AS newest_year FROM movies;
categories: SELECT CATEGORY FROM movies WHERE CATEGORY IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(CATEGORY) <> '';
languages: SELECT LANGUAGES FROM movies WHERE LANGUAGES IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(LANGUAGES) <> '';
countries: SELECT COUNTRY FROM movies WHERE COUNTRY IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(COUNTRY) <> '';
release_years: SELECT `YEAR` AS release_year, COUNT(*) AS movie_count FROM movies WHERE `YEAR` IS NOT NULL AND `YEAR` > 0 GROUP BY `YEAR` ORDER BY `YEAR`;
health: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(FILEPATH = 'MISSING'), 0) AS missing_files, COALESCE(SUM(FILEPATH LIKE '%-Get.Better.Copy%'), 0) AS needs_better_copy_count, COALESCE(SUM(PICTURENAME IS NULL OR TRIM(PICTURENAME) = ''), 0) AS missing_posters, COALESCE(SUM(FORMATTEDTITLE IS NULL OR TRIM(FORMATTEDTITLE) = '' OR YEAR IS NULL OR YEAR = 0 OR RATING IS NULL OR RATING = 0 OR URL IS NULL OR TRIM(URL) = '' OR DESCRIPTION IS NULL OR TRIM(DESCRIPTION) = ''), 0) AS incomplete_metadata FROM movies;
missing_files_rows: SELECT NUM, ORIGINALTITLE, FORMATTEDTITLE, YEAR, URL FROM movies WHERE FILEPATH = 'MISSING' ORDER BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(ORIGINALTITLE), ''), FORMATTEDTITLE), YEAR, NUM;
missing_posters_rows: SELECT NUM, ORIGINALTITLE, FORMATTEDTITLE, YEAR, URL FROM movies WHERE PICTURENAME IS NULL OR TRIM(PICTURENAME) = '' ORDER BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(ORIGINALTITLE), ''), FORMATTEDTITLE), YEAR, NUM;
incomplete_metadata_rows: SELECT NUM, ORIGINALTITLE, FORMATTEDTITLE, YEAR, URL FROM movies WHERE FORMATTEDTITLE IS NULL OR TRIM(FORMATTEDTITLE) = '' OR YEAR IS NULL OR YEAR = 0 OR RATING IS NULL OR RATING = 0 OR URL IS NULL OR TRIM(URL) = '' OR DESCRIPTION IS NULL OR TRIM(DESCRIPTION) = '' ORDER BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(ORIGINALTITLE), ''), FORMATTEDTITLE), YEAR, NUM;
missing_files: SELECT COUNT(*) AS missing_files FROM movies WHERE FILEPATH = 'MISSING';
needs_better_copy_count: SELECT COUNT(*) AS needs_better_copy FROM movies WHERE FILEPATH LIKE '%-Get.Better.Copy%';
needs_better_copy_val: SELECT m.NUM, m.ORIGINALTITLE, m.FORMATTEDTITLE, m.YEAR, m.URL FROM movies m WHERE m.FILEPATH LIKE '%-Get.Better.Copy%' ORDER BY m.NUM;
duplicate_count: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM movies m JOIN (SELECT URL FROM movies WHERE NUM NOT IN ('6717', '6718') AND URL LIKE '%https://www.imdb.com/title/tt%' GROUP BY URL HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) dup ON m.URL = dup.URL WHERE m.NUM NOT IN ('6717', '6718') AND m.URL LIKE '%https://www.imdb.com/title/tt%';
duplicate_rows: SELECT m.NUM, m.ORIGINALTITLE, m.URL, m.YEAR, dup.dup_count FROM movies m JOIN (SELECT URL, COUNT(*) AS dup_count FROM movies WHERE NUM NOT IN ('6717', '6718') AND URL LIKE '%https://www.imdb.com/title/tt%' GROUP BY URL HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) dup ON m.URL = dup.URL WHERE m.NUM NOT IN ('6717', '6718') AND m.URL LIKE '%https://www.imdb.com/title/tt%' ORDER BY dup.dup_count DESC, m.URL, m.NUM;
